name: LoweringAction
description: Transform high-level structured operations (linalg.matmul, linalg.conv_2d_nchw_fchw) into lower-level loop nests with explicit iteration and memory access patterns. Exposes iteration structure for further optimization passes such as tiling, fusion, and vectorization.

parameters.name: operation_type
parameters.description: The type of structured operation to lower. Supported values: 'matmul' for linalg.matmul, 'conv_2d_nchw_fchw' for 2D convolution in NCHW format.

parameters.name: enable_iterator_type_semantics
parameters.description: If True, preserve iterator type semantics during lowering to enable semantics-preserving fusion and reductions. If False, perform a simpler structural lowering.
